description: This file contains C source code for handling WRG headers in MTD devices, including functions for fixing MD5 checksums and updating headers in flash memory.

methods.name: wrg_fix_md5
methods.description: Calculates and updates the MD5 checksum in the WRG header.

methods.name: mtd_fixwrg
methods.description: Fixes the WRG header in an MTD device at a specified offset.
